initial_state: Separate 1000 USDT cash account, no inherited position
rule: Unchanged WBC01 weekly rule and 100 USDT entry budget
costs: Unchanged hypothetical 10 bps fee and 2 bps impact per execution; stress impact 3 bps

review_policy.scheduled_review: After the complete fixed interval and input integrity checks
review_policy.interim_use: Operational integrity monitoring only; no tuning or early success decision
review_policy.economic_screen: Base net, stressed net and base net excluding best trade must each be positive to merit further review
review_policy.insufficient_evidence: Few trades or concentrated outcomes remain inconclusive even if the economic screen passes
review_policy.promotion: None automatic; no statistical power or live profitability claim
review_policy.failure: Preserve result; do not retune on this evaluation window

limitations: Prospective relative to registration, not statistically independent observations or regimes.
Historical public candle replay with assumed costs is not live paper execution.
26 weeks is a fixed observation budget, not a guarantee of sufficient trades or completion of the original scalping goal.
No orders, credentials, leverage, or background process are started.
